column1: # Long paths must resolve. KNOWN_ISSUES.md item 19: a pathname of 24 bytes or more
# killed VFS - it wrote the REQ_LOOKUP terminator one byte past the 56-byte message
# at exactly 24, and truncated anything longer to 24 bytes and resolved the wrong
# name. The path now travels in a grant.
# The lengths bracket that 24-byte boundary so a regression names the length it
# stopped at, and every read-back is a marker no other step can print: the guest
# echoes the command, so only real output satisfies one (a write step has no
# expectation of its own - its evidence is the read-back under it).
# Nothing here goes above 24: *creating* a name longer than 28 bytes is a separate
# defect, still open (KNOWN_ISSUES.md item 20 - `create`/`mkdir`/`mknod` embed the
# name and fail with ENOENT past 28), and a step for it belongs with that fix.
